stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Why did an age of -4 get a ticket?

stations.title: Booking desk
stations.text: Takes any number it is handed

captions: The booking desk. Bridie wants it to refuse what cannot be, and to say why.
Today an age of -4 gets a child ticket, and nobody hears about it.
You throw exceptions that refuse bad values, and one the compiler makes callers plan for.
Now a bad value is refused with a message, before anything changes.
The desk says no when it must. Next, the hut is closed up whatever goes wrong.
